answer: Give every identity a long run of small, binding choices with no right answer - which jetty to mend, which haven rule to fund, which stranger to answer first - and pay only identities whose choices stay consistent with their own stated reasons. Independent agents diverge naturally; clones begin as mirror images of one operator, so either he scripts one decision tree for all of them and their identical fingerprints expose the cluster, or he deliberates separately for every shell, and scale costs as much as honesty.
